fields.summary: Email notification templates use hardcoded company name
fields.description:
The email notification templates (welcome email, password reset, invoice emails) all have the company name hardcoded as 'Acme Corp' instead of reading it from the tenant configuration. White-label customers see incorrect branding.

This is causing significant confusion for B2B customers who have rebranded the product.

comments.body: Two enterprise customers complained about this in the last week. One threatened to churn.
